title: Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026 – 90 Posts
description:
**High Court of Kerala**
invites Online Applications for 90 Contract posts of System Assistant in District Judiciary. Eligible candidates wishing to apply for
**Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026**
can apply on its recruitment portal from November 20, 2026 till December 14, 2026. The selected candidates will be assigned to the job of providing technical support and maintenance of computer systems and digital services in district courts across Kerala. It’s suggested to candidates who have received
**Kerala High Court Recruitment 2026**
notification to read the official notification carefully. There are 14 judicial districts with opportunities available for those with a diploma or a computer-related degree. The candidates should also have the following hardware troubleshooting experience. No fee for the application and it involves screening and an interview. Candidates interested in the
**judiciary job openings**
can also avail this opportunity when they are looking for technical support jobs.
  
  
Understanding the Court Behind This Hiring Drive
  
  
**High Court of Kerala**
is the highest court of the state and is located at Ernakulam and is responsible for the recruitment of personnel assisting the district courts of Kerala. The court makes use of its recruitment site to recruit technical staff to support electronic court services. This contractual position is suitable for candidates interested in pursuing their careers in Judiciary Work in India. The candidates who apply for this
**Kerala High Court System Assistant Vacancy 2026**
should keep it in mind that the employment is temporary and subject to the court’s requirements.
  
  
Seat Allocation for Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026
  
  
Name of Judicial District Total Vacancies Thiruvananthapuram 10 Kollam 8 Pathanamthitta 4 Alappuzha 7 Kottayam 7 Thodupuzha 4 Ernakulam 12 Thrissur 7 Palakkad 7 Manjeri 5 Kozhikode 8 Kalpetta 3 Thalassery 6 Kasargod 2
**Total Vacancies**
**90**
Cost of Applying
  
  

* All Categories: No application fee.
* Payment Mode: Not applicable

Schedule Highlights for Aspirants
  
  

* Notification Date: November 10, 2026
* Application Start Date: November 20, 2026
* Last Date to Apply: December 14, 2026

**Academic And Experience Requirements**
Requirement Details Qualification
  
  

* Government approved three-year Diploma in Computer or Electronics
* Or B.Sc. (Computer Science) or BCA
* Higher qualifications in these fields are also accepted

Experience
  
  

* At least two years in hardware troubleshooting
* Basic knowledge of computer networking
* Applicants must hold an experience certificate in the prescribed format

Desired Experience
  
  

* One year in the eCourts project in Kerala
* Or one year on any Linux based platform

Eligibility
  
  

* Qualification and experience must be acquired on or before November 10, 2026
* Candidates from outside Kerala need an equivalency or recognition certificate

Nationality
  
  

* Qualified Indian citizens only

Age Norms for Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026
  
  

* Birth Date Rule: Candidates must be born on or after January 2, 1985

Monthly Earnings and Contract Terms
  
  

* Monthly Pay: Rs. 24,590/- consolidated
* Contract Period: Initially 2 years
* Extension: Possible based on performance, court orders and government sanction
* Regularization: Contract staff cannot claim permanent appointment
* Rank List Validity: 2 years from the final rank list publication

Career Growth Opportunities for System Assistants
  
  

* Application Development and Computer Support: Obtain real world experience in developing online applications and providing computer support to court users.
* Technical Skill Development: Understand hardware troubleshooting and system maintenance; and technical support.
* eCourts Awareness: Be aware of the prevalence of virtual courts and the technology-enabled judicial services.
* Linux Platform Skills: Get experience in managing and supporting Linux platforms.
* Troubleshooting Skills: Gain troubleshooting skills by thinking through the mechanics of technical problems.
* Professional Networking: Engage with authorities from the courts and technical assistances.
* Possible work: Use this experience in the search for employment in the IT support, hardware maintenance and system administration fields.
* Experience in Public Sector: Make the public sector works experience in the judicial institutions entered in your profile to get more chances of Kerala High Court Recruitment 2026.

Papers to Keep Handy
  
  
Document Purpose Diploma, B.Sc. or BCA certificate Proof of essential qualification Government Order for higher qualification Proof supporting a claimed higher qualification Equivalency or recognition certificate Required for qualifications obtained outside Kerala Hardware troubleshooting experience certificate Proof of two years’ experience in the prescribed format Desired experience certificate Proof of eCourts or Linux experience, if available Photograph and signature Scanned images for online application Age proof Document confirming date of birth Identity proof Valid document confirming identity Other relevant documents Supporting records for eligibility claims
  
  
Reasons to Apply Early and Accurately
  
  

* Last-Minute Technicalities: Candidates should submit their applications early to avoid potential website delays or server failures near the deadline.
* Check Your Qualifications: Confirm your degree/diploma and work experience qualify you to work in the UK.
* Upload Documents: Upload successfully scanned copies of your certificates and experiences documents following the prescribed way.
* District Preference: Decide your district preference carefully as the posts may be allocated according to rank list and also for administrative convenience.
* Get Track of Recruitment Notification: Track the portal for screening results, Interview call letter and more updates on Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026.

Hiring Stages for Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026
  
  

* All online applications will be first prescreened against eligibility criteria of the notification by the High Court.
* Shortlisting of candidates will be done after passing the screening interview and eligibility criteria will not ensure an interview call.
* The documents uploaded will be checked and only the confirmed candidates will be called for interview.
* Two weeks prior to the interview, call letters will be available for download on candidate profile and alert will be provided by SMS / e-mail.
* The shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and final merit list will be based on the performance of the shortlisted candidates in the interview.
* Successful candidates will be appointed to Government Jobs in Kerala in district courts and the allotment of districts will be decided by the rank and requirement of the candidate by the High Court.
* Original certificates will be checked at the final stage and the selection of the mode of selection or the notification can be modified or cancelled by the court at any time.

Step-by-Step Guide to Apply Online
  
  

* Go to the official website of the High Court of Kerala at hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in
* Click the “What’s New” section of the portal and choose the advertisement titled as “Notification issued – System Assistant in the District Judiciary on contract basis“
* Carefully read the complete notification and the How to Apply guidelines before applying.
* If you don’t already have a registration, complete the One Time Registration here using the registration login link.
* Sign in and complete my profile with personal information and qualifications.
* Have the photo and signature scanned and in the proper format.
* Candidates must click on the Apply Now button on the post of System Assistant in the Dashboard and follow the on-screen instructions to apply.
* Provide legible and legation copies of documents of qualification and experience and other supporting documents.
* Check the whole application thoroughly and send it only if you have checked all the details.
* Keep the printed copy of your completed application to use as a reference. Do not submit it to the High Court.
* The applicant from outside India shall have to communicate the public Ip address of the Internet connection used by him/ her to the following email i.e., recruitment.hckerala@nic.in and also inform to the High Court when he/ she submit the application.

Key Guidelines Every Candidate Should Follow
  
  

* Document Quality: Make sure all document you uploaded is clear and readable. Please do not re-upload or delete any documents after shearing.
* Recognition Certificate: Candidates having degree or Diploma from any Universities/Institutions outside Kerala will have to take recognition certificate from Kerala Universities.
* Portal Monitoring: Candidates applying for Kerala High Court System Assistant Recruitment 2026 should check the official portal at least once a week for interview updates.
* Note: Regional representation or canvassing or misconduct during an interview may disqualify and will lead to canceling the interview.
* Power of Court: The Court can vary or cancel the notification. The decision as to eligibility and interview shall be final.

FAQs
  
  
Minimum three years Diploma in Computer/Electronics, B.Sc. Computer Science, BCA or its equivalent is a must. They should also have a minimum of 2 years of hardware troubleshooting experience. The deadlines for these requirements are November 10, 2026.
  
  
There are 90 System Assistant Job openings in Kerala District Judiciary as mentioned in the notification. All the candidates will be required to choose their district in the online application. Final allotment of district will be based on rank list and requirement of the High Court.
  
  
Online applications will be received in the High Court from November 20, 2026 to December 14, 2026. Applications are to be submitted before the deadline.
